snippet.title: Military Base Tidy Up Date
snippet.description:
🪖 Military Base Tidy Up releases tomorrow, November 11th!
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/5484400/Military_Base_Tidy_Up

Time to turn this forgotten underground base into a perfectly organized bunker! 📦 Shelve weapons, ammo and gear, unlock new sectors, and build your tidying skills.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play solo or team up with up to 4 players in online co-op. No timers, no pressure. Just pure organizing satisfaction!
